title: Majority Element II
statement:
Given an integer array of size n, find all elements that appear more than ⌊ n/3 ⌋ times.

Return every distinct value appearing more than floor(n/3) times, sorted in ascending numeric order.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums = [3,2,3]
Output: [3]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: nums = [1]
Output: [1]
```

### Example 3

```text
Input: nums = [1,2]
Output: [1,2]
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 5 * 10^4
- -10^9 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^9
- Follow up: Could you solve the problem in linear time and in O(1) space?
